design_provenance.target: Voynich remains sealed and was never scored by v1.
design_provenance.v1_data_role: The 400 development, 200 calibration, and 250 validation manuscripts from v1 have been inspected and may be used only for v2 design/training/calibration as explicitly declared below. They cannot count as v2 confirmation.
v1_key_findings: broad four-class raw validation accuracy 99.6% R0 / 98.8% R1 after merging working_set_only and line_reset_r64
v1 OOD was calibrated in-sample and failed out of sample
working_set_only vs line_reset_r64 unresolved at 1.17/1.26 null SD

scientific_question: Can a hierarchical, mechanism-targeted assay identify the source architecture of a manuscript-scale surface process while controlling out-of-sample abstention and specifically separating working-set-only from physical-line-reset R64 memory?

stage_a.classifier: Recompute corrected v1 five-way fold logistic models from v1 development only; aggregate fold log probabilities to manuscript posterior; collapse P(working_set_only)+P(line_reset_r64) into P(base_local); broad prediction is raw argmax with no posterior-confidence abstention.
stage_a.features: exact v1 20-feature directional recurrence vectors, five physical folds
stage_a.name: broad_source_gate
stage_a.ood: For each broad class and representation, concatenate five fold-standardised 20-vectors (100D). Fit LedoitWolf centre/covariance on v1 development broad-class manuscripts. Set broad-class distance threshold only from the separate v1 calibration manuscripts using the higher split-conformal 95% order statistic. No in-sample development quantile is permitted.

stage_b.classifier: Per representation, fixed five-feature L2 logistic regression C=1 using [gain_line_reset_vs_zero, gain_page_r64_vs_zero, exact_same_minus_cross_lag2_5, exact_same_minus_cross_lag6_16, cachehit_same_minus_cross_lag2_64], manuscript features are means across five physical folds.
stage_b.likelihood_definition: zero/page/line models share identical RegionalModel probabilities and MU. Page model uses ordinary RegionalState. Line model uses a subclass that clears only page_seq whenever physical line changes. Both page and line lambda are selected on synthetic training only by four-way bifolium CV over the inherited lambda grid.
stage_b.name: working_vs_line_reset_gate
stage_b.recurrence_null: 64 deterministic within-page token-order permutations preserving page token multiset and line-position skeleton; Jeffreys smoothed rates; log2 observed/null excess.

target.name: Voynich
target.open_rule: Only after Stage A, Stage B, unknown-control, representation, leakage, and required power-report gates all pass on fresh v2 confirmation data.
permitted_outcomes: identified named source if Stage A and B agree in both representations and target is in-distribution
base_local unresolved if Stage A selects base_local but Stage B representations/confidence do not agree
